question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

TENSILE
solution:
The correct answer is **Stretchable**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 The most appropriate synonym is **Stretchable**.
 
 
• 
 It means to extend in length. (लंबाई में विस्तार करने के लिए।)

 
 
• 
 ​For example, He stretched his neck to see what was going on.
 
 
 
 
• 
 Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct option is 2.
